Class JsonParser.Builder

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.json.JsonParser.Builder
Enclosing class:
JsonParser
public static final class JsonParser.Builder extends Object
Builds a parser. Its defaults: a depth of 1 000 nested objects and arrays, no limit on the length of a document besides that of an array, strings of up to 20 000 000 bytes, numbers of up to 1 000 bytes, and unknown members ignored by binding.
Since:
0.1.0

    • maxDepth

      public JsonParser.Builder maxDepth(int maxDepth)
      Sets the maximum number of nested objects and arrays. Binding recurses with the document, so this limit also bounds the stack it uses.
      Parameters:
      maxDepth - the maximum depth
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if maxDepth is less than 1

    • maxNumberLength

      public JsonParser.Builder maxNumberLength(int maxNumberLength)
      Sets the maximum length of a number, in bytes, as written. Converting a long number to a BigDecimal or a BigInteger takes more than linear time.
      Parameters:
      maxNumberLength - the maximum length
      Returns:
      this builder
      Throws:
